definitions: A person or thing that makes something plumper.
A small, light object, often made of cork or rubber, used by actors to fill out their cheeks and make them appear fuller.
A type of fishing lure designed to imitate a small, plump fish.
examples: She used a special plumper to give her lips a fuller look.
The actor inserted plumpers into his cheeks for the role.
He cast the plumper near the lily pads.
